decisions.reason: The completed system layout and CAD must incorporate the newly specified 5.5-inch base, 12 oz cup clearance, and edge-to-edge machine footprint.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: This is what I have in mind: the base should be five and a half inches tall so our 12oz cups can fit beneath the spouts. The machine should fit perfectly on top and sit edge to edge with the base.

value_updates.raised_platform_layout_constraint: The system layout and CAD must include a 5.5-inch-tall base that provides clearance for 12 oz cups beneath the spouts and matches the machine footprint edge to edge.

decisions.reason: The physical platform height, cup clearance, and footprint do not change the current electrical wiring-plan requirements.
